name: Polynomial Objective Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicit "lexicographically smallest" tie-break text with an equivalent polynomial objective function ($\sum f_i \cdot 4^{n-i}$). Models that rely on pattern-matching will fail to recognize this as a lexicographical tie-break and will likely attempt to find all valid profiles to compute and compare their signatures, which will TLE on sparse graphs or cause integer overflows. Models that genuinely reason will mathematically deduce that $4^{n-i}$ dominates the remaining terms, meaning the first valid profile found via ordered DFS is the global minimum without needing to evaluate the sum.
